speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying the duration and triggers. Has this rash spread to your trunk or face, and do you notice any scaling or crusting on the lesions? Please also tell me if you have a family history of similar skin conditions or if anyone in your household has had recent infections.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on the bilateral upper extremities. I also have No fever, No joint pains, No recent illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Nummular Eczema (Discoid Eczema). The chronicity (5 months), bilateral distribution on the upper extremities, and lack of systemic symptoms or scaling make this the most likely diagnosis despite the initial description lacking specific morphology. I recommend a trial of topical corticosteroids and emollients; if no improvement, a skin biopsy will be required to rule out other conditions.
